text: I've had persistent tooth sensitivity for two years. Many clinics have tried various methods – tapping, blowing air, X-rays – and said things like worn tooth necks or decayed teeth. But here, the dentist found the decay immediately on an X-ray; it was the last tooth, at the back, and couldn't be reached by brushing. They scheduled an extraction, but not just any dentist; they only scheduled an appointment with a specialist. The dentist was incredibly gentle; it only hurt a little with the anesthetic injection. The extraction was done in 20 minutes. I'm extremely impressed. It's also close to home, and the price for one tooth extraction was reasonable, just over 1000 baht. This is definitely my go-to clinic.
